value.name: Lucia signs affidavit
value.description: Lucia finishes signing the affidavit with a heavy, uneven hand, leaving the ink dark and permanent on the page.
evidence: atched out her name in a heavy, uneven hand
When she lifted the pen the ink sat dark and irretrievable on the paper

value.name: Asha takes pen from Lucia
value.description: Asha carefully eases the pen out of Lucia's grip and moves the signed page across to Rosa.
evidence: Asha eased the pen out of Lucia's grip with the care of someone lifting a splinter
and slid the signed page across the vinyl until it came to rest under Rosa's waiting palm

value.name: Rosa signs affidavit
value.description: Rosa signs her name more steadily and deeply than Lucia, scoring the page beneath.
evidence: Rosa took the pen without ceremony, braced the affidavit against her thigh, and signed her own name in a blockier, steadier hand than Lucia's
the letters pressed deep enough to score the page beneath

value.name: Rosa aligns signatures
value.description: Rosa flattens the page so both signatures sit in the same column and pushes the stack back toward Asha.
evidence: When she was done she flattened the sheet against Lucia's signature so the two names sat in the same column
and pushed the stack back toward Asha

value.name: Lucia withdraws into silence
value.description: Lucia watches the papers move without speaking and slips her empty hand back into her cardigan pocket where the letter had been.
evidence: Lucia watched the transfer without speaking
her empty hand drifting back into the cardigan pocket where the letter had been

value.name: Daniel's return approaches
value.description: As the windshield beads with rain, the dashboard clock advances toward the hour Daniel will return to the study.
evidence: the windshield went on beading at its edges as the dashboard clock advanced another minute toward the hour Daniel would walk back into the study

value.name: Rosa squares and returns papers
value.description: Rosa gathers the loose pages, squares them with firm taps, and slides the stack back to Asha with the letter on top and the signed affidavits beneath.
evidence: Rosa drew the loose pages together against her thigh, squared the edges with two firm taps, and pressed the stack flat before sliding it back across the seat into Asha's hands
the letter went on top, the two signed affidavits beneath

value.name: Asha secures documents
value.description: Asha accepts the returned documents and holds her palm over the top sheet to keep them in place.
evidence: Asha took them without speaking and laid her palm over the top sheet
